patch_description: Replace the naive per-destination Dijkstra broadcast with a Takahashi-Matsuyama-style Steiner tree heuristic. We grow a shared tree from the source: for each remaining destination we run multi-source Dijkstra from all current tree nodes to find the cheapest attachment point, attach the cheapest destination, and record only the *new* edges (dedup via seen_edges) for each partition. This eliminates redundant transfers over edges shared by multiple destinations, since each shared edge is only paid once per partition rather than once per destination. All edges of the tree are still appended for each partition (required so every partition can reach every destination), but overlapping path segments across destinations are deduplicated per partition.
